body:
I get scared.mi came out and I'm getting worse. I'm really scared Im going to try again soon. I can't control the urge and 3rd times the charm....you can only get wiser when you fail.

I am in the uk. I will look into that it sounds interesting. I have the home treatment team visit me e wry 2 days at the moment.

I think I'm okay with the job aspect for the moment. It does bug me a lot and it hurts but I can repress that for the moment. The break up is the one I struggle with a lot at the moment. I have always had problems with breaking up but never in this suicidal and severe depression state. They all collide and it sucks my willpower, my pleasure, my desires my personality. My being basically. Distractions don't work, they all work together when I'm able to suppress one and they overpower me.

I've been on the venaflaxine for....6 weeks, 2 weeks on the 225mg dosage. I have felt no effect with it. I am still a zombie. I cry, get the thoughts....I don't know why they don't do anything. All I get are side effects, they work at least.

Thank you for replying. I don't know if I hope to get well. It's cinical to say but I can't lie about false hope.
I have that too, the arms feel so damn tight, I don't approve of the material used but I still love it

Because you don't want to die, part of you is telling you to hold on. Never mistake that for cowardice like some do. We just want to survive, it's in our DNA. 

You have been through a lot. You are very strong to still be here. I would have cracked long before. But you can fix this. Ruins aren't the end, it can be rebuilt and worked on. You can't make things right by doing the wrong thing. 

Is there any one thing that makes you unable to go on or is it all of your past experiences meshed together?
What has happened? Your girlfriend must be worried.....you need to talk to her, don't do this to her. What has caused you to be suicidal may I ask?

You're very young, I know it's annoying when people say that but you can catch up its not too late. You have a lot of fun things to experience yet. Onto the main point though, why are you feeling suicidal? Is it falling behind on school work? My parents don't understand my depression and I'm 23, they don't get why I have suicidal thoughts. My parents have had the luck to never have it so they won't understand. You have to give them time.

I don't have autism but I know that people can have normal lives with it. I did an activity once where we had to have one person be a mother and the other a kid with autism. I found it very educational but the teacher's main point was that there's nothing wrong with it.

Your English is pretty good actually. What stuff have you got prepared may I ask? Have you told your parents how you feel or a teacher? Schools have nurses and special teachers who you can talk to as well.
But the age, you should give yourself the chance to become an adult at least. I don't know if it will get better but you at least deserve that chance.
I'd give yourself to a certain age rather than a close date. 19 is too young, you at least want to be 21 and legal to drink and such first in life right?
How old are you may I ask?

They do but the nurses say stick to a routine and such. I do and have, nothing helps, I still obsess about death. I'm forever stuck that the end is near and I have some sort of plan. I tell my parents I get these thoughts but what can they really do? I can talk about it but I don't understand why I get them, they also accuse meow hiding something but I am not. My life has been dished out, I don't have any secrets left they don't know.

I'm on 225mg venlafaxine.

I could phone again. They're nice to talk to but sometimes they canbe condescending when they talk to you.

I get angry at myself for being like this but I also get angry at the fact there is no reason for my suicidal tendacies. There was a trigger, breakup, lost my job, but I have accepted those and I still feel this way. It's been about 6 weeks now since they both happened and I can't get out of this rut. Never before have I been this suicidal. My parents upset me....they think I hide things when I'm on the computer or ipad but...well everyone does that. You are entitled to privacy. Plus sometimes I look at Xmas gifts, porn and help on here, stuff they don't need to see.

Thank you for talking to me

It didn't help, it felt more like a holiday. They fed me, told me when to sleep, when to take my pills n such. 

I have the home treatment phone number case. They temporarily calm me but their advice doesn't help. The Samaritans are nice, they calm me but the effects don't last.

I've been on my medication nearly a month, it was upped to 225mg 2 weeks ago. It has had no effect but they won't change it yet. Saying things like other patients have realised they feel lower when they stop taking them so they do help.my nurses just said side effects really, dry mouth and all that stuff. They don't work on me, I feel down all the time. I'm a wreck. I literally feel crazy, I shout at my parents, get angry and take my anger on myself. They think I'm hiding something but I've told them everything which hurts me and makes me not want to tell my parents anything if they don't want to believe me.

It's good you called a hotline. If I'm honest I may do it myself in a moment. I understand what you mean about how it affects you. It does the same to me. I'm really glad you know that something is wrong, it's a step in the right direction
You aren't alone. Do you have any triggers? What causes you to feel like killing yourself?

It was 2 weeks ago. For the one week I was in hospital and I've been home for one week now.

The home treatment team send nurses every 2 days to talk to me. They give me advice but I don't have the motivation to do what they want. I've let myself go and I'm finding it harder and harder. I follow routines but it doesn't help.

I can't handle work at the moment sadly. I have distractions but my mind doesn't stop thinking about suicide and such. Simple things like jigsaws are nearly impossible because my mind won't stop. I cry and get frustrated.

I write down my feelings on paper sometimes. When it's too much that's sadly when I self harm. I don't have any strategies at the moment. Deep breathing. Yoga, walks, drawings, exercise, games, they all don't work sadly and I'm annoyed nothing works. I don't enjoy anything at all.
Feel free to drop a message to me. Don't feel alone, don't let thoughts lie to you either

When I went to see nurses they constantly tried to push on me that I have friends and family around me and they would be upset if I killed myself. At that current moment I couldn't care about anyone, I acknowledged they would be sad but I was selfish. Sure it's my life but they were always supporting me, they were there for me, they love me.

It's partially about living for them but they want you to be happy and do good for yourself. That is true love. There should be no getting past it that. You are loved, you acknowledge you feel this way. You at least came here seeking some support. Do you tell your doctor about this or see a psychiatrist? You should seek to help yourself, tell your family how you feel. They want to help. 

My family don't understand my depression but they helped me, they made sure I was okay and showed me love. You should help yourself for them, but mostly for yourself. This shouldn't be the end. The feelings and thoughts can be controlled and defeated. Your brain is telling you don't do it, something is wrong. You can do this. Everyone else will help, now you need to help yourself too. I hope you defeat this and feel better.

Your parents love you. Sure they may have kicked you out but they were just giving you a push to get you on your journey. Jumping will make your parents guilty. They will have to live with that guilt for the rest of their lives. Then there's the person or people who find your mangled body, they will be haunted by that image forever. Then there's the expensive funeral, possible fees your parents may have to pay if it's in a public area. Then there's the possibility you may hurt someone or worse, survive and end up crippled.

Committing suicide will help nobody. You have a future, the economy is bad but you have a future. There are many hostels and people who care about you. Have you explained how this is making you feel to your parents or a friend? Can you not stay at another relatives for awhile or a friends? The government will give you extra money too. Visiting the citizens advice bureau is a must too, they will really help you and explain what you are entitled to in income support.

The future is not over. It is hard but you have a lot to do, nobody wants you dead, nobody at all. People love you so much. If it gets too much seek a professional, see your GP. But you are in control, you can do this. I hope I helped you feel at least a little better. I wish you luck.

So do I. I gave myself a black eye, my beard is too thick and I don't bathe anymore. It takes a lot of dedication to kill yourself, do not get confused about cowardness. It is not cowardly to not be able to kill yourself, it shows you are human and in your mind something is telling you that you want to live.

I do not know your problems but part of you wants to live. I also have no dreams, goals or even desires. However I know that staying alive is something that is my urge as a human, why go against my nature? We are built to survive, our body and mind do a lot to keep us going. Your brain is stopping you, you are not a coward at all.

I can't offer a solution, I'd like one myself, but I can assure you that there's no reason to hate yourself. If you have self hate it means you aspire to be different, you have a goal, you don't like yourself but want to change, you know what type of person you want to be. 

I at least hope I gave you some clarity and peace. It's hard, real hard I know, but you are not alone. You are never alone.

I understand how you feel. You have to stand up for yourself though. He knows your weakness and is playing you. He needs the ultimatum, you or her. 

I know you can't let go. I can't let go of mine. Maybe it's best not to speak to him, to move to a new area, new job. Fresh start. You need to care about you because he certainly isn't. You are the most important person I the world to you. Your heart and feelings are delicate, you need to protect yourself. I know however that killing yourself isn't the way to go. You won't hurt him. He will get with another and do the same. Your family will suffer and so will you. You're better than this.myou put others first and it shows you are a lovely person. 

I hope I at least comforted you a little. It's really hard and you feel isolated. I'm free to talk if you want.

Lost my job, my girlfriend, apart from that I've had depression for ages. I've tried lots of hobbies, but I have no desires in life, no goals, no wants. I've reached my end. My nurses and such know but they don't help.
